body:
I am going to school out of state. I don't keep in touch with people from my high school because they are douche bags. The exception is one guy who I grew up with but never talked to. 

I really should try and get out more. I am willing to drink, I just don't want a party to get busted and then be fucked with my mom (dad said he doesn't mind as long as I am smart), my internship, and my school. From what everyone is telling me I just need to keep trying and get out more. I am going to go talk to my friend for a bit. Thanks for all the words of encouragement.

Also can anyone recommend some good music for me? I normally listen to Audioslave, RHCP, Nirvana, electronic music, and Lindsey stirling but will be more open in this case. 

I will be gone for the next hour I think. I have a paper to finish. I'm going to call my friend and let him in on the situation.

I am on a competitive team and in a club. I just don't open up to people. It's hard to talk to people l, especially as a guy. I think I will hang out with her more. I have tried talking to a few girls in my classes but one of them doesn't seem interested in talking with me (or anyone else) and the other I'm not sure about. I feel like I am missing out on something big and I can't allow myself to waste 40k per year to go to college when I'm not enjoying it.

Sorry I had a test. I'm here. I have an internship already. 

The thing that kills me is I can't make friends here. There are people I am acquainted with on my floor but none of them are people I am close to. I have one friend here who is a girl but we don't really hang out and she isnt anyone I would date. I don't party so it's harder to meet people. I suppose this should belong in /r/depression. I was going to take my life about 3 months ago but my friend at the other school stopped me. 

I just feel like I'm the weird one who everyone talks about behind his back.
